nom: Urban Veda Radiance Brightening Face Scrub

segments.sensitive: Sensitive skin reviewers are split: several report gentle, non-irritating use with no breakouts or redness, while others describe a raised rash, eczema flare-up, or nervousness that turned out fine only after cautious testing.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry/sensitive skin liked the light grit texture but did not tolerate the fragrance.
segments.combination: No specific mentions of combination skin in the reviews.

concerns.aging: No reviewer specifically links this product to aging concerns.
concerns.dehydration: No reviewer specifically links this product to dehydration or dryness relief.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports no irritation or redness after use, even when combined with other actives like night cream or facial oil.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers describe barrier-related reactions, one developing a raised rash and another eczema, the latter noting it may have followed use of a chemical exfoliant too soon before; other sensitive-skin users report no such issues.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers with acne-prone or scarred skin report fading of old scarring and reduced pigmentation/dark spots after weeks of regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report mixed but mostly positive results: one says the scrub does not irritate her acne or cause breakouts, another explicitly avoids recommending it for acne-prone skin due to a rash reaction.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer specifically addresses oil control or oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Small beads hard to rinse off
Skin feels soft and smooth after use
Attractive packaging and ease of use

extraits.texte: I've had this product for two months now. I would not recommend for sensitive, acne-prone skin. I continue to attempt to use it, but it gives me a raised rash reaction all over my face, especially my forehead and chin.

After using it for a while it began giving me eczema. I think it's because I forgot I had used a chemical exfoliating product too close to using this. Just a turn off though. It does smell nice to me though. Oh also it is really hard to get all the little beads off. A wash cloth wet didn't work. I had to splash water on my face several times and that gets annoying when I just want to polish my face real quick

extraits.titre: Love the texture, hate the scent!
extraits.texte: Must be my pregnancy hormones but I just did not like the smell. I loved the light grit texture, perfect for my dry/sensitive skin. If the smell was better I'd say it'd be a part of my weekly routine! I did end up returning it ):

I received a small sample of the Urban Veda turmeric face scrub & was amazed at the difference in my skin texture after the first application. I have sensitive, acne prone skin & wanted something for my skin that would help with old scarring & also help soothe my skin at the same time. AMAZING!!! It's been 3 weeks & I exfoliate every four days and the appearance of my skin is smoother & softer. Most of my scars are lighter in colour & depth. One happy lady x

Compared to other facial exfoliants this opens up my pores to a healthy level, and feels incredibly gentle on my skin. There is no irritation or redness after it, and using the night cream or facial oil after this just makes my skin feel so soft, and renewed :) I definitely recommend it.

I followed the directions and used it a couple times a week and my face is soooo soft and bright. It takes off all the dead skin cells really well. I have sensitive skin and was nervous about the smell. But no breakouts or irritation. I wish I knew about this product tear as ago. I think I'm going to try to use this daily like some of the reviews have mentioned.
Makes my skin glow! Doesn't irritate my acne prone skin, makes my pores look smaller! Smells great, easy to wash off! Overall win win win!!!!
